# Vocaplace

> India's #1 Pay After Placement Digital Marketing & AI Automation Course with 100% Job Guarantee.

## Overview
Vocaplace is an intensive 120-day (4-month) digital marketing bootcamp and vocational training academy based in India. Students master Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Google Ads (PPC), Meta Ads, Social Media Marketing, and AI Marketing Automation workflows.

## Key Highlights & Performance Metrics
- **Placement Model:** Pay After Placement (Income Share Agreement / ISA).
- **Job Guarantee:** 100% Placement Guarantee.
- **Salary Target:** ₹4 LPA to ₹8.5 LPA (Average starting salary: ₹6.5 LPA).
- **Course Duration:** 120 Days (4 Months).
- **Rating:** 4.9/5 from 5,000+ students trained.
- **Hiring Partners:** 100+ partner agencies and tech companies across India (including OYO, Swiggy, Paytm, Nykaa).

## Lead Instructor
- **Wajed Sk:** 20+ years of digital marketing leadership, Online Faculty at Victoria University Australia (Sydney Campus), former Chief Digital Marketing Instructor at Unacademy, guest speaker/trainer at IIM and Google MSME.

## Core Curriculum Modules
1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Technical audits, crawlability, on-page optimization, backlink strategies, keyword research.
2. Google Ads & Paid Media: Search ads, Performance Max (PMax), Display networks, Smart bidding, CRO.
3. Social Media & Meta Advertising: Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager, creative strategy, copy testing, lookalike audiences.
4. AI Marketing Automation: ChatGPT agent workflows, Midjourney creatives, Zapier/Make automation, programmatic SEO.
